newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-PFEIFENBERGER BACK IN AUSTRIA SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PFEIFENBERGER BACK IN AUSTRIA SQUAD.

text.p: Werder Bremen's Heimo Pfeifenberger has returned to the Austrian squad after a two-match absence for Sunday's World Cup qualifier in Latvia.
A recurring toe injury forced the midfielder to miss the games against Scotland and Estonia in April.
There were no other changes in the squad announced on Monday:
Goalkeepers: Michael Konsel (Rapid Vienna), Franz Wohlfahrt (Stuttgart).
Defenders: Wolfgang Feiersinger (Borussia Dortmund), Walter Kogler (Salzburg), Anton Pfeffer (Austria Vienna), Peter Schoettel (Rapid Vienna).

Midfielders: Andreas Heraf (Rapid Vienna), Andreas Herzog (Werder Bremen), Heimo Pfeifenberger (Werder Bremen), Dietmar Kuehbauer (Rapid Vienna), Roman Maehlich (Sturm Graz), Markus Schopp (Hamburg), Peter Stoeger (Rapid Vienna).
Forwards: Harald Cerny (1860 Munich), Anton Polster (Cologne), Dieter Ramusch (Casino Graz), Ivica Vastic (Sturm Graz), Arnold Wetl (Porto).
